# The last watering rota

Rain returned and the watering rota kept generating reminders. Removed the recurring task instead of teaching everyone to ignore it until spring. [[Garden notebook]] can record a season ending without calling it a lapse. A reminder that outlives its reason makes the next necessary reminder easier to dismiss.
